svg.title: JATIYA SANGSAD BHABAN — OCTAGONAL PLAN & LAKEFRONT ELEVATION
svg.desc: Orthographic master plan and waterfront elevation of Louis Kahn’s National Assembly Building in Dhaka detailing the 47.2 m octagonal parliamentary hall, 8 buffer towers, geometric cutouts, and marble lift bands.
